title: Email signature
slide_intent: Teach senders to make contact information easy to scan in the limited formatting environment of an email client.
strategic_value: A repeatable signature can identify museum staff across email clients while giving the person’s name, role and links a predictable order.
demonstration: A numbered list pairs six settings with callouts on a mail-window specimen. The name uses Arial Bold at 12 pt, the body Arial Regular at 12 pt, and the optional black PNG logo is 47 px high.
practical_value: Set the signature from the six labels, check that website and newsletter links remain distinct, and place any exhibition promotion below the signature.

content_islands.name: Setup instructions
content_islands.spec: Place the numbered settings in the left column. Include the optional mark, rule of thirty en dashes, two type roles and two links.

content_islands.name: Exhibition note
content_islands.spec: Below the settings, explain the optional image for promoting an exhibition.

content_islands.name: Annotated mail window
content_islands.spec: Show the signature at the bottom of a mostly empty message. Align six leader lines from the numbered callouts to the corresponding parts.
